comments.author: Hunter Jozwiak
comments.text:
Review finding literal context:
- File: /home/sektor/projects/slackbuilds/.codex/skills/slkbuild-validation/scripts/validate_pkg.sh:189
- Severity: P2
- The firmware-installer validator currently requires linux-firmware/WHENCE.
- k/firmware-installer/SLKBUILD removes $PKG/linux-firmware before packaging, so that path cannot exist in final .txz artifacts.
- Result: systematic false FAIL for valid firmware-installer builds.
- Fix: remove that check or switch to a shipped path such as WHENCE.linux-firmware.

title: Validator falsely fails on tar entries prefixed with ./
description: The payload validation script in .codex/skills/slkbuild-validation/scripts/validate_pkg.sh checks exact tar entry names such as install/slack-desc. Many package archives list entries as ./install/slack-desc, which causes false missing-path failures and returns FAIL for valid artifacts. Normalize leading ./ before path checks.

title: validator: fallback to grep when rg is unavailable
description:
The slkbuild-validation validator script uses rg for log error scanning and success-marker detection without a fallback. On minimal Slackware/Slint environments where ripgrep is not installed, valid build logs are flagged as FAIL with 'Success marker missing' even when 'Slackware package ... created.' is present.

File: .codex/skills/slkbuild-validation/scripts/validate_pkg.sh (around success marker check near line 93).

Acceptance criteria:
- Guard rg usage with command -v rg
- Use grep fallback for all rg-based checks
- Preserve existing behavior when rg is installed
- No false FAIL due solely to missing rg binary
close_reason: Implemented rg->grep fallback in validator and added no-rg regression coverage.

title: modules-installer fails when kernel archive paths are prefixed with ./
description: k/modules-installer/SLKBUILD extracts only lib/modules from kernel package archives. Kernel tarballs commonly store paths as ./lib/modules/...; in that case tar reports 'Not found in archive' and build aborts. Update extraction logic to handle both prefixed and unprefixed archive paths so modules-installer package creation succeeds.
